id: 06_Two Way and Three-Way Control of Lamp Basic Electrical Engineering Laboratory VT
title: 双控与三地控制照明实验
source_doc: course/Basic Electrical Engineering Lab/06_Two Way and Three-Way Control of Lamp Basic Electrical Engineering Laboratory VT.md
author_source: project/Basic Electrical Engineering Lab/06_Two Way and Three-Way Control of Lamp Basic Electrical Engineering Laboratory VT/src.py

points.S2: 断电接线，教师检查后通电

shots.scene: 欣欣站在楼梯口，楼梯上下各有一个开关，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at the foot of a staircase with a light switch at the bottom and another at the top, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课做双控和三地控制照明实验。
overlay: 双控与三地控制照明实验

shots.scene: 一盏灯连着两个开关和三个开关的两组图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: one lamp linked to two switches, and one lamp linked to three switches. No people.
shots.narration: 一盏灯，两处、三处都能开关。

shots.scene: 阿杰走到楼梯顶，回头发现楼下的灯关不了
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reaches the top of a staircase and looks back at a lamp he cannot switch off from upstairs.
shots.narration: 阿杰上了楼，楼下的灯却关不掉。

shots.scene: 小研在楼上按开关，灯灭了
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student presses a switch at the top of the stairs and the lamp turns off.
shots.narration: 小研在楼上一按，灯就灭了。

shots.scene: 阿杰惊讶地挠头，欣欣在旁边竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head in surprise while the panda mascot raises one finger beside him.
shots.narration: 秘密就在开关的接法里。

shots.scene: 楼梯上下两个开关控制同一盏灯的示意
shots.prompt_en: A staircase icon with a switch at the bottom and the top, both linked to one ceiling lamp. No people.
shots.narration: 双控：两个地点控制同一盏灯。

shots.scene: 卧室门口和床头各一个开关控制吊灯
shots.prompt_en: A bedroom icon with one switch by the door and one by the bed, both linked to the ceiling lamp. No people.
shots.narration: 楼梯常用，卧室也能用。

shots.scene: 两只双控开关之间加了一只中间开关
shots.prompt_en: An icon of two two-way switches with an intermediate switch placed between them, all linked to one lamp. No people.
shots.narration: 再加一只中间开关，就能三地控制。

shots.scene: 空白实验记录本上画着两张空表
shots.prompt_en: A blank lab notebook showing two empty table grids. No people.
shots.narration: 目的：实现两地、三地控灯，列出真值表。

shots.scene: 实验台上摆着两只双控开关、一只中间开关、一个灯泡和导线
shots.prompt_en: On a lab bench: two two-way switches, one intermediate switch, an incandescent bulb in a holder and a bundle of connecting leads. No people.
shots.narration: 器材：两只双控开关，一只中间开关。

shots.scene: 开关和灯泡旁各有一块空白铭牌
shots.prompt_en: Blank rating labels beside each switch and the bulb. No people.
shots.narration: 还有一盏白炽灯和连接导线，额定值要相配。

shots.scene: 电路图：相线经熔断器接到第一只开关的公共端
shots.prompt_en: A circuit diagram icon: the line wire passes through a fuse to the common terminal of the first two-way switch. No people.
shots.narration: 相线先经熔断器，接到开关一的公共端。

shots.scene: 两只开关之间两根导线对应相连
shots.prompt_en: The diagram shows two wires linking the two outer terminals of switch one to the two outer terminals of switch two. No people.
shots.narration: 两只开关的两个触点，对应连起来。

shots.scene: 开关二的公共端接灯，灯另一端接中性线
shots.prompt_en: The diagram shows switch two's common terminal wired to the lamp, and the lamp's other end to the neutral wire. No people.
shots.narration: 开关二公共端接灯，灯再接中性线。

shots.scene: 小研在透明接线板上按图插线，电源开关处于断开状态
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student plugs leads into a transparent wiring board following a blank diagram; the bench power switch is clearly off.
shots.narration: 备齐器材，按图一根根接线。

shots.scene: 接好的导线逐根打勾
shots.prompt_en: The connected leads on the board each get a small green check. No people.
shots.narration: 先连两开关之间，再接灯和中性线。

shots.scene: 小研扳动开关一，灯亮
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student flips switch one by its handle and the bulb lights up.
shots.narration: 扳动开关一，灯亮了。

shots.scene: 阿杰扳动开关二，灯灭
shots.prompt_en: The young male student flips switch two by its handle and the bulb goes out.
shots.narration: 再扳开关二，灯又灭了。

shots.scene: 一张 4 行真值表，只有亮灯和灭灯图标
shots.prompt_en: A four-row table with only lamp-on and lamp-off icons in the last column, other cells blank. No people.
shots.narration: 把四种开关状态记成真值表。

shots.scene: 两开关同侧时灯亮，异侧时灯灭
shots.prompt_en: Two switch pairs: both levers pointing the same way with a lit lamp, pointing opposite ways with a dark lamp. No people.
shots.narration: 两开关位置对应，灯亮；错开，灯灭。

shots.scene: 中间开关内部两条平行连线
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway icon of an intermediate switch with two straight parallel links inside. No people.
shots.narration: 中间开关有两种状态：一是直连。

shots.scene: 中间开关内部两条交叉连线
shots.prompt_en: The same intermediate switch icon now with two crossed links inside. No people.
shots.narration: 二是交叉连接。

shots.scene: 直连和交叉同时出现的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon showing straight and crossed links at the same time, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 两种状态，同一时刻只能有一种。

shots.scene: 电路图：开关一的两个触点连到中间开关一侧
shots.prompt_en: A circuit diagram icon: the two outer terminals of switch one wired to one side of the intermediate switch. No people.
shots.narration: 开关一的两根线，接到中间开关一侧。

shots.scene: 中间开关另一侧连到开关二，开关二接灯
shots.prompt_en: The diagram continues: the other side of the intermediate switch wired to switch two, and switch two to the lamp and neutral. No people.
shots.narration: 另一侧接开关二，再接灯和中性线。

shots.scene: 老周在接线板上加装中间开关并插线（电源断开）
shots.prompt_en: The older man adds an intermediate switch to the wiring board and plugs in leads while the bench power is off.
shots.narration: 在两只开关之间，接入中间开关。

shots.scene: 中间开关扳上、扳下两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons of the intermediate switch lever: up with straight links, down with crossed links. No people.
shots.narration: 扳上是直连，扳下是交叉。

shots.scene: 中间开关扳上，阿杰轮流扳动两只双控开关
shots.prompt_en: With the intermediate switch up, the young male student flips the two two-way switches in turn by their handles.
shots.narration: 先在直连状态下，扳动两只开关。

shots.scene: 中间开关扳下，再轮流扳动
shots.prompt_en: With the intermediate switch down, the young male student flips the two switches again while the female graduate student records.
shots.narration: 再换成交叉状态，重复一遍。

shots.scene: 一张 8 行真值表，上半与下半用颜色区分
shots.prompt_en: An eight-row table with the top half shaded one color and the bottom half another, only lamp icons in the last column. No people.
shots.narration: 三地控制，一共八种状态。

shots.scene: 上半表亮灭顺序与双控相同，下半表完全相反
shots.prompt_en: The top half shows lamp on, off, off, on; the bottom half shows off, on, on, off. No people.
shots.narration: 直连和双控一样，交叉正好相反。

shots.scene: 亮灯图标旁是 1，灭灯旁是 0
shots.prompt_en: A lit lamp icon next to the digit one and a dark lamp icon next to the digit zero. No people.
shots.narration: 亮记 1，灭记 0，逻辑一目了然。

shots.scene: 大仓库里三个门口各有一个开关
shots.prompt_en: A large warehouse icon with a switch at each of three doors, all linked to the hall lights. No people.
shots.narration: 大仓库、粮库，多处都要能开关灯。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着两地和三地控制的两张图
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the two-way and three-way control diagrams on a board.
shots.narration: 双控两地控灯，加中间开关三地控灯。

shots.scene: 房屋图标里的楼梯灯
shots.prompt_en: A house icon with a staircase lamp highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 弄懂开关逻辑，家里布线也明白了。

shots.scene: 熔断器和开关都串在相线上，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A circuit icon with the fuse and switches all in the line wire and a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 熔断器和开关，都要串在相线上。

shots.scene: 开关串在零线上的图标被红叉划掉，灯座仍有闪电符号
shots.prompt_en: A circuit icon with the switch in the neutral wire and a lightning symbol still on the lamp holder, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 开关接在零线上，关了灯，灯座照样带电。

shots.scene: 螺口灯座：中心触点接相线，螺纹接零线
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway icon of a screw lamp holder: the center contact linked to the line wire, the screw shell to neutral. No people.
shots.narration: 螺口灯座，螺纹那头接零线。

shots.section_title: 断电接线，教师检查后通电
shots.scene: 阿杰先拉下实验台总开关，再插线
shots.prompt_en: The young male student switches off the bench main switch before plugging leads into the wiring board.
shots.narration: 接线、改线、拆线，一律先断电。
overlay: 断电接线，教师检查后通电

shots.section_title: 断电接线，教师检查后通电
shots.scene: 王老师对照电路图逐根检查
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks every lead on the wiring board against a blank circuit diagram.
shots.narration: 接好后，请老师逐根检查。

shots.section_title: 断电接线，教师检查后通电
shots.scene: 王老师点头，阿杰合闸
shots.prompt_en: After the safety administrator nods, the young male student switches on the bench power.
shots.narration: 老师同意了，才能合闸通电。

shots.section_title: 断电接线，教师检查后通电
shots.scene: 改接三地控制前，先断电
shots.prompt_en: An icon sequence: power switch off, then a new intermediate switch added to the board. No people.
shots.narration: 从双控改三地控制，也要先断电。

shots.scene: 手指只按开关手柄，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A close-up icon of a finger flipping only the plastic switch lever, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 通电后，只碰开关手柄。

shots.scene: 手碰插孔、插头金属和灯座的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a hand touching an open socket hole, a metal plug tip and a lamp holder, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 插孔、插头金属、灯座，一概不碰。

shots.scene: 手表、戒指图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a metal wristwatch and a ring crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 摘下手表戒指等金属饰品。

shots.scene: 亮着的灯泡上方有热浪
shots.prompt_en: Heat waves rising from a glowing incandescent bulb. No people.
shots.narration: 白炽灯亮一会儿就很烫。

shots.scene: 断电后等待，再用手拧下灯泡
shots.prompt_en: An icon sequence: power switch off, a clock, then a hand unscrewing a cooled bulb. No people.
shots.narration: 换灯泡：先断电，等凉了再拧。

shots.scene: 灯泡旁的纸张被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A sheet of paper lying against a lit bulb, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 灯泡旁边不放纸张杂物。

shots.scene: 熔断器里的熔丝断开
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway icon of a fuse with its fuse wire melted apart. No people.
shots.narration: 熔丝断了，说明电路有问题。

shots.scene: 老李断电后查线路，找到碰在一起的导线
shots.prompt_en: With the power off, the facility engineer inspects the wiring board and finds two bare wire ends touching.
shots.narration: 先断电，请老师查明短路原因。

shots.scene: 用铜丝代替熔丝的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a thick copper wire replacing a fuse, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 绝不能用铜丝铁丝代替熔丝。

shots.scene: 阿杰触电倒在台边，小研冲去拉下总闸
shots.prompt_en: The young male student slumps beside the bench after an electric shock; the female graduate student rushes to pull the main switch.
shots.narration: 有人触电，先断电，不徒手拉人。

shots.scene: 老周打电话，老李在旁照护
shots.prompt_en: The older man calls on a mobile phone with a blank screen while the facility engineer, trained in first aid, attends to the young male student.
shots.narration: 拨打 120，受过培训的人施救。

shots.scene: 接线板冒烟，老李拉闸后用二氧化碳灭火器
shots.prompt_en: The wiring board starts smoking; the facility engineer switches off the power and uses a carbon dioxide extinguisher.
shots.narration: 电气起火，先断电，不用水浇。

shots.scene: 火势变大，众人撤离，保卫处值班员打电话
shots.prompt_en: The fire grows; everyone leaves under an exit sign while the security officer calls on a phone.
shots.narration: 控制不住就撤离，拨打 119。

shots.scene: 小研向王老师报告，保卫处值班员记录
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reports to the safety administrator while the security officer writes on a blank clipboard.
shots.narration: 报告实验室负责人、学院和保卫处。

shots.scene: 双控和三地控制两张电路图
shots.prompt_en: Two circuit diagram icons: two-way control and three-way control with an intermediate switch. No people.
shots.narration: 双控两只开关，三地再加中间开关。

shots.scene: 4 行和 8 行两张真值表
shots.prompt_en: A four-row table and an eight-row table with lamp icons. No people.
shots.narration: 真值表：双控四种，三地八种。

shots.scene: 相线上的熔断器和开关、断电开关、老师检查三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a fuse and switch in the line wire, a switched-off power switch, and a teacher checking a circuit. No people.
shots.narration: 开关接相线，断电接线，查过再通电。

shots.scene: 开关手柄、冷却的灯泡、灭火器三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a switch lever, a cooled bulb, and a fire extinguisher. No people.
shots.narration: 只碰手柄，凉了换灯，异常先断电。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在楼梯中间，按下开关，灯亮，挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands halfway up the staircase, presses a switch so the lamp lights, and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 哪里都能开关，安全一直在线，下次见！
